verdict.rationale: Copilot's transparency note says it can run code to do complex calculations and generate graphs, which covers computed answers and charts. The Analyst agent and Copilot in Excel are documented for analyzing user-supplied data. Producing downloadable output files from executed code is not evidenced, and the code-execution claim is a single brief mention with no independent hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: documented downloadable file outputs from code runs, explicit confirmation that code runs on user-uploaded data, in-depth documentation of the code-execution environment, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant write and run code on my data to produce charts, computed answers, and downloadable files
